comments.author: @robertfelix4139
comments.text: This AI video is mostly nonesense,  Slapping a script about St. Lucia over a video clip of a woman cutting a banana layout or families gathering muddy water from open ground is flat-out offensive to the actual infrastructure of the island. Those clips are visibly filmed in rural, non-Caribbean tropical regions.mixing in generic B-roll footage of water scarcity or different agricultural settings from other continents is entirely inaccurate and misleading. St. Lucian culture and the local workforce are distinct, vibrant, and deeply tied to the Caribbean landscape—not the manufactured "struggle" narrative depicted in generic global stock clips.

replies.author: @LifewaysTravel
replies.text: Thanks for the fair feedback. Just to clarify, this video was researched, written, edited, and produced by our human team, not automatically generated by AI. That said, your criticism about the visuals is fair. Sometimes your research may miss local details, and when location-specific footage is limited, we have used illustrative footage to support the narration. We understand that this can weaken the authenticity of a place like St. Lucia when the visuals clearly don't match the island. We appreciate you pointing out the specific problems, and we'll take that seriously as we work to improve the accuracy of both our research and footage selection. 🙏

replies.author: @martinacrafton1252
replies.text:
​@LifewaysTravelThere are many mispronounciations in this video, the most important being the name of the island which is Saint Lucia (LOOSHA).
 Gros Islet in the north, was named by the French, therefore pronounced as per French (large island). The names of the  various towns  villages, mountains and bays are predominantly French as our island changed colonial hands between. The French and the British 14 times.

The videography, though reversed in many views, is excellent, however, the script is very repetitive.

Why do we choose to stay, or return  to live in  St, Lucia despite the challenges  of any small island state?
Because we , the Sons and Daughters of Saint Lucia , love the land that gave us birth.❤🇱🇨
